videos.title: You cannot outsource your creativity to the models | Market Hang
videos.description:
Michael Monaghan, Partner and Portfolio Manager at Founder ETFs, says you can hand a model the mental labor but not the creative work, and that creativity sits upstream of the thinking. Darius Dale, Founder and CEO of 42 Macro, makes the structural case: going deeper down a rabbit hole is a race you now lose, so the surviving skill is carrying knowledge across disciplines. Mark Newton of Fundstrat Global Advisors points out that price action is about octaves, and host Nancy Tengler argues anybody could build a spreadsheet and now AI can.

Watch the full episode: https://youtube.com/live/jKmxb7VTxdU

Market Hang is live weekdays 12:30-1:30pm ET on Yahoo Finance.
